sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "storage_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "value" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "runs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('active', 'paused', 'finished')), "started_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at_us" INTEGER, "ended_utc_offset_s" INTEGER CHECK (ended_utc_offset_s BETWEEN -64800 AND 64800));
CREATE TRIGGER runs_offset_insert BEFORE INSERT ON runs WHEN NEW.ended_utc_offset_s IS NOT NULL AND NEW.ended_at_us IS NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'offset without end');END
CREATE TRIGGER runs_offset_update BEFORE UPDATE ON runs WHEN NEW.ended_utc_offset_s IS NOT NULL AND NEW.ended_at_us IS NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'offset without end');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "laps" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "run_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "lap_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "marked_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lap_time_s" REAL NOT NULL, UNIQUE(run_id, lap_index));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "run_gaps" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "run_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('manual_pause', 'position_loss', 'heart_rate_loss', 'interruption')), "start_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_us" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX run_gaps_run_time ON run_gaps (run_id, start_us)
CREATE INDEX laps_run_time ON laps (run_id, marked_at_us)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "raw_positions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "run_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "time_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('present', 'estimated', 'unavailable', 'discarded')), "latitude_deg" REAL, "longitude_deg" REAL, "accuracy_m" REAL, "speed_mps" REAL, "speed_accuracy_mps" REAL, "vertical_accuracy_m" REAL, CHECK(state = 'unavailable' OR(latitude_deg IS NOT NULL AND longitude_deg IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "raw_heart_rates" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "run_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "time_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('present', 'estimated', 'unavailable', 'discarded')), "bpm" INTEGER, "contact" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (contact IN ('good', 'poor', 'unsupported')), CHECK(state = 'unavailable' OR bpm IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "raw_altitudes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "run_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "time_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('present', 'estimated', 'unavailable', 'discarded')), "altitude_m" REAL, "vertical_accuracy_m" REAL, CHECK(state = 'unavailable' OR altitude_m IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "raw_steps" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "run_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "time_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('present', 'estimated', 'unavailable', 'discarded')), "step_count" INTEGER, CHECK(state = 'unavailable' OR step_count IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "raw_rr_packets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "run_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "time_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "rr" BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(rr) > 0 AND length(rr) % 2 = 0));
CREATE INDEX raw_positions_run_time ON raw_positions (run_id, time_us)
CREATE INDEX raw_heart_rates_run_time ON raw_heart_rates (run_id, time_us)
CREATE INDEX raw_altitudes_run_time ON raw_altitudes (run_id, time_us)
CREATE INDEX raw_steps_run_time ON raw_steps (run_id, time_us)
CREATE INDEX raw_rr_packets_run_time ON raw_rr_packets (run_id, time_us)
CREATE TRIGGER raw_positions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON raw_positions BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'raw data is append-only');END
CREATE TRIGGER raw_heart_rates_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON raw_heart_rates BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'raw data is append-only');END
CREATE TRIGGER raw_altitudes_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON raw_altitudes BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'raw data is append-only');END
CREATE TRIGGER raw_steps_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON raw_steps BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'raw data is append-only');END
CREATE TRIGGER raw_rr_packets_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON raw_rr_packets BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'raw data is append-only');END

CREATE TRIGGER raw_positions_no_direct_delete BEFORE DELETE ON raw_positions WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM runs WHERE id = OLD.run_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'raw data is deleted only with its run');END

CREATE TRIGGER raw_heart_rates_no_direct_delete BEFORE DELETE ON raw_heart_rates WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM runs WHERE id = OLD.run_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'raw data is deleted only with its run');END

CREATE TRIGGER raw_altitudes_no_direct_delete BEFORE DELETE ON raw_altitudes WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM runs WHERE id = OLD.run_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'raw data is deleted only with its run');END
CREATE TRIGGER raw_steps_no_direct_delete BEFORE DELETE ON raw_steps WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM runs WHERE id = OLD.run_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'raw data is deleted only with its run');END

CREATE TRIGGER raw_rr_packets_no_direct_delete BEFORE DELETE ON raw_rr_packets WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM runs WHERE id = OLD.run_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'raw data is deleted only with its run');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "preprocessing_results" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "run_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES runs(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "method_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "parameter_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "computed_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_time_s" REAL, "moving_time_s" REAL, "distance_m" REAL, "bridged_distance_m" REAL, "average_bpm" REAL, "max_bpm" INTEGER, "median_bpm" REAL, "best_pace_s_per_km" REAL, "lap_count" INTEGER, "heart_rate_time_s" REAL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "preprocessed_samples" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "run_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "channel" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('position', 'heart_rate', 'altitude', 'steps')), "raw_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "time_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('present', 'estimated', 'unavailable', 'discarded')), "discard_reason" TEXT CHECK (discard_reason IN ('accuracy', 'hardJump', 'softJump', 'nonMonotonicTime', 'implausibleHeartRate', 'noContact', 'heartRateOutlier', 'verticalAccuracy', 'invalidValue')));
CREATE INDEX preprocessed_samples_run_time ON preprocessed_samples (run_id, channel, time_us)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "preprocessed_spans" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "run_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('moving', 'settling', 'position_gap', 'heart_rate_gap')), "start_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_us" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX preprocessed_spans_run_time ON preprocessed_spans (run_id, kind, start_us)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rated_sections" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "run_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "start_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "method_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "parameter_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "assessed_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "heart_rate_present" INTEGER NOT NULL, "heart_rate_estimated" INTEGER NOT NULL, "heart_rate_unavailable" INTEGER NOT NULL, "heart_rate_discarded" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position_present" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position_estimated" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position_unavailable" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position_discarded" INTEGER NOT NULL, "missing_heart_rate_share" REAL NOT NULL, "longest_heart_rate_gap_s" REAL NOT NULL, "meets_heart_rate_gap_rule" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (meets_heart_rate_gap_rule IN (0, 1)), "settling_overlap_s" REAL NOT NULL, "settling_share" REAL NOT NULL, "gps_gaps" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(gps_gaps)));
CREATE INDEX rated_sections_run_time ON rated_sections (run_id, start_us)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "computed_values" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "run_id" INTEGER REFERENCES runs(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "day" TEXT, "value_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('original', 'current')), "value_real" REAL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "computed_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "data_from_us" INTEGER, "data_to_us" INTEGER, "measurement_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sources" TEXT NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "method_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "parameter_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "quality" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (quality IN ('provisional', 'sufficient', 'good', 'undeterminable')), "unavailable_reason" TEXT, "hr_max_bpm" INTEGER CHECK (hr_max_bpm > 0), "hr_rest_bpm" INTEGER CHECK (hr_rest_bpm > 0), "hr_max_is_estimated" INTEGER CHECK (hr_max_is_estimated IN (0, 1)), CHECK((run_id IS NULL)<>(day IS NULL)));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX computed_values_run_unique ON computed_values (run_id, value_key, role) WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX computed_values_day_unique ON computed_values (day, value_key, role) WHERE day IS NOT NULL
CREATE TRIGGER computed_values_original_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON computed_values WHEN OLD.role = 'original' OR NEW.role = 'original' BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'original value is immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER computed_values_reason_insert BEFORE INSERT ON computed_values WHEN(NEW.value_real IS NULL)=(NEW.unavailable_reason IS NULL)BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'value and unavailable_reason are exclusive');END

CREATE TRIGGER computed_values_reason_update BEFORE UPDATE ON computed_values WHEN(NEW.value_real IS NULL)=(NEW.unavailable_reason IS NULL)BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'value and unavailable_reason are exclusive');END

CREATE TRIGGER computed_values_basis_insert BEFORE INSERT ON computed_values WHEN NEW.hr_max_is_estimated IS NULL AND(NEW.hr_max_bpm IS NOT NULL OR NEW.hr_rest_bpm IS NOT NULL)BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'basis values without snapshot flag');END

CREATE TRIGGER computed_values_basis_update BEFORE UPDATE ON computed_values WHEN NEW.hr_max_is_estimated IS NULL AND(NEW.hr_max_bpm IS NOT NULL OR NEW.hr_rest_bpm IS NOT NULL)BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'basis values without snapshot flag');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "value_sections" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "computed_value_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES computed_values(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (position >= 0), "start_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_us" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (end_us >= start_us), "gps_median_accuracy_m" REAL CHECK (gps_median_accuracy_m >= 0), "weight" REAL NOT NULL CHECK (weight >= 0), "late_factor" REAL NOT NULL CHECK (late_factor >= 0), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('eligible', 'provisional', 'rejected')), "discard" TEXT CHECK (discard IN ('implausible', 'incomplete', 'zeroWeight')), "reasons" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(reasons)), "oxygen_demand" REAL, "estimate" REAL, UNIQUE(computed_value_id, position));

CREATE TRIGGER value_sections_original_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON value_sections WHEN (SELECT role FROM computed_values WHERE id = OLD.computed_value_id) = 'original' OR (SELECT role FROM computed_values WHERE id = NEW.computed_value_id) = 'original' BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'original value sections are immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER value_sections_original_no_late_insert BEFORE INSERT ON value_sections WHEN (SELECT role FROM computed_values WHERE id = NEW.computed_value_id) = 'original' AND NEW.computed_value_id <> (SELECT MAX(id) FROM computed_values) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'original value sections are immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profile" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), "birth_year" INTEGER CHECK (birth_year > 0), "body_weight_kg" REAL CHECK (body_weight_kg > 0), "body_height_m" REAL CHECK (body_height_m > 0), "resting_heart_rate_bpm" INTEGER, "max_heart_rate_bpm" INTEGER, "weekly_run_minutes" INTEGER, "training_days_mask" INTEGER CHECK (training_days_mask BETWEEN 0 AND 127), "usual_training_minutes" INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "known_devices" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "display_name" TEXT, "is_preferred" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_preferred IN (0, 1)), "added_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX known_devices_one_preferred ON known_devices (is_preferred) WHERE is_preferred = 1
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "consents" ("source_key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('granted', 'revoked')), "changed_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "run_feedback" ("run_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES runs(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "rpe" INTEGER CHECK (rpe IS NULL OR(typeof(rpe) = 'integer' AND rpe BETWEEN 0 AND 10)), "wellbeing" INTEGER CHECK (wellbeing IS NULL OR(typeof(wellbeing) = 'integer' AND wellbeing BETWEEN 1 AND 5)), "complaints" TEXT, "warning_answer" TEXT CHECK (warning_answer IN ('yes', 'no')), "note" TEXT, "srpe_points" REAL CHECK (srpe_points >= 0), "srpe_duration_s" REAL CHECK (srpe_duration_s >= 0), "srpe_method" TEXT, "srpe_method_version" INTEGER, CHECK(warning_answer IS NULL OR complaints IS NOT NULL), CHECK((srpe_points IS NULL AND srpe_duration_s IS NULL AND srpe_method IS NULL AND srpe_method_version IS NULL)OR(srpe_points IS NOT NULL AND srpe_duration_s IS NOT NULL AND srpe_method IS NOT NULL AND srpe_method_version IS NOT NULL AND rpe IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "manual_trainings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "day" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (day GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(day) IS day), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('run', 'other')), "duration_s" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(duration_s) = 'integer' AND duration_s > 0), "rpe" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(rpe) = 'integer' AND rpe BETWEEN 0 AND 10));
CREATE INDEX manual_trainings_day ON manual_trainings (day)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reference_performances" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('race', 'test', 'confirmedRun')), "distance_m" REAL NOT NULL CHECK (distance_m > 0), "time_s" REAL NOT NULL CHECK (time_s > 0), "performed_on" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (date(performed_on) IS performed_on), "created_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "run_id" INTEGER REFERENCES runs(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, CHECK(kind <> 'confirmedRun' OR run_id IS NOT NULL));
CREATE INDEX reference_performances_run ON reference_performances (run_id)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rejected_suggestions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "run_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES runs(id)ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('distance', 'time', 'open')), "distance" TEXT CHECK (distance IN ('fiveKilometers', 'tenKilometers', 'halfMarathon')), "target_s" REAL CHECK (target_s > 0), "target_date" TEXT CHECK (date(target_date) IS target_date), "run_days" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (run_days BETWEEN 1 AND 127), "max_session_s" REAL NOT NULL CHECK (max_session_s > 0), "weekly_cap_s" REAL NOT NULL CHECK (weekly_cap_s > 0), "current_weekly_s" REAL CHECK (current_weekly_s > 0), "can_run_30" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (can_run_30 IN ('yes', 'no', 'unknown')), "hard_session" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (hard_session IN (0, 1)), "created_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK((type = 'open' AND distance IS NULL AND target_s IS NULL AND target_date IS NULL)OR(type = 'distance' AND distance IS NOT NULL AND target_s IS NULL)OR(type = 'time' AND distance IS NOT NULL AND target_s IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plans" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "goal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES goals(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "created_at_us" INTEGER NOT NULL, "valid_from" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (date(valid_from) IS valid_from), "trigger" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ("trigger" IN ('create', 'goalChange', 'weekly', 'feedback', 'run', 'pause', 'manual', 'ruleVersion')), "reason" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(reason) > 0), "method" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(method) > 0), "method_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (method_version >= 1), "parameter_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (parameter_version >= 1), "inputs" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(inputs)), "summary" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(summary)));
CREATE INDEX plans_goal ON plans (goal_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_units" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "plan_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES plans(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "day" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (date(day) IS day), "week" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (week >= 0), "phase" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (phase IN ('entry', 'build', 'reduction')), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('easy', 'long', 'intervals', 'tempo', 'progressive', 'walkRun', 'rest')), "minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (minutes >= 0), "structure" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(structure)), "run_id" INTEGER REFERENCES runs(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (pinned IN (0, 1)), "fixed" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' CHECK (fixed IN ('none', 'day', 'kind', 'easyForHard') AND(fixed = 'none' OR(pinned = 1 AND(fixed = 'day')=(kind = 'rest')AND(fixed <> 'easyForHard' OR kind = 'easy')))));
CREATE INDEX plan_units_day ON plan_units (day)
CREATE INDEX plan_units_plan ON plan_units (plan_id)
CREATE INDEX plan_units_run ON plan_units (run_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "active_warning" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), "reported_on" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reported_on GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(reported_on) IS reported_on), "source" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('manual', 'run_feedback')), "run_id" INTEGER CHECK (run_id IS NULL OR typeof(run_id) = 'integer'));
